title: Running after every chance
explanation: The source uses this comparison for someone rushing about in pursuit of money. It can criticise restless chasing, but it is a dismissive expression rather than a neutral description of a person.
meaning_odia: ଲାଭ ଆଶାରେ ଏଠିସେଠି ଅସ୍ଥିର ହୋଇ ଧାଇଁବାକୁ ଏହି ତୁଳନାରେ କୁହାଯାଏ। ଲୋକଙ୍କୁ ତୁଚ୍ଛ କରି କହିବାର ସ୍ୱର ଥିବାରୁ ପ୍ରୟୋଗରେ ସାବଧାନତା ଦରକାର।
usage_example: A fictional speaker complains that a neighbour keeps chasing every rumoured windfall. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The captured example supplies the money-seeking situation. This is an animal comparison, not a statement about human worth.
